purpose: Append-only factual and output-contract clarification; acceptance limits unchanged

comparison_row_count.cause: Earlier summaries called the freeze gate's183 unchanged rows '183 gated metrics'. Independent recount of regression_gate.compare shows that count included informational rows.
comparison_row_count.requirement: Every baseline metric remains required under the unchanged comparison tool. No missing/worse gated metric, no waiver; no row is dropped because of this correction.

freshness_scope.finding: The ROS watchdog shares the detector's single-thread executor. A stalled callback can prevent watchdog publication. A queued status can also arrive late at the browser.
freshness_scope.contract: Validity is checked at output publication, not a promise that an un-timestamped topic remains current. Add evaluated_at_utc_s, max_result_age_s and future_tolerance_s. Actionable consumers must independently expire status from that timestamp plus the reported source/residence age, and detect stream silence.
freshness_scope.clock_requirement: Node, source publisher and live dashboard UTC clocks must be synchronized within the declared tolerance. Unknown/non-finite/future timestamps fail closed; historical file playback remains a historical snapshot.
freshness_scope.browser: Validate transport age on arrival, then use a monotonic local expiry timer. Preserve its own last STOP through invalid non-STOP messages until a freshly validated non-STOP clears it. Missing timing metadata cannot permit live GO.
freshness_scope.limits_unchanged: Default maximum age0.5s, future tolerance0.05s; browser and node timer scheduling are not hard real-time guarantees. No braking safety certification is claimed.
